name: Redacted Dutch extradition case 25/03473

attribution.legal_posture: Dutch courts held extradition legally permissible and the Supreme Court rejected cassation on 2026-01-27. DOJ separately reported Pedro Ernesto Alonso de los Reyes in Dutch custody awaiting extradition on 2026-05-06. The cross-source mapping remains researcher-assessed because the Dutch decisions redact the name; the record stops short of completed surrender, a U.S. arraignment, conviction, or factual guilt finding.

caveats: The charges remain allegations, and extradition litigation determines procedure rather than guilt.
The cited record leaves extradition completion and U.S. custody unverified.
Keep this as a separate procedural lead unless an official source explicitly identifies the requested person.

The Dutch decisions redact the requested person's name. The proposed match to Pedro Ernesto Alonso de los Reyes is a high-confidence researcher assessment from nationality, court, dates, charges, alleged role, and case chronology; the court's printed record omits that name.

statements: The Supreme Court of the Netherlands rejected the requested person's cassation appeal on January 27, 2026, leaving intact the lower court's declaration that extradition to the United States was permissible. The official Dutch sources redact the name. The mapping to Pedro Ernesto Alonso de los Reyes is supported by the combined exact fingerprint: Mexican nationality; U.S. prosecution in the Southern District of Florida; January 7, 2025 complaint and warrant; January 21, 2025 indictment; the same four conspiracy categories; alleged provision of identity and financial enablement; and the DPRK remote-IT-worker revenue purpose. DOJ independently stated on May 6, 2026 that de los Reyes was in Dutch custody awaiting extradition.
limitations: Record as extradition judicial review resolved against the requested person, with surrender still pending as of DOJ's May 6, 2026 release. Do not describe this as extradited, transferred to U.S. custody, arraigned in the United States, convicted, sentenced, or found factually guilty.
